The exact SHA-256-bound application lock retains zvariant/derive 5.15.1 and zbus_names 4.3.5 through zbus/zbus_macros 5.19.0. Updated tauri-plugin-notification 2.8.0, notify-rust 4.18.2, secret-service 5.2.0 and zbus-secret-service-keyring-store 1.0.1 still independently constrain zbus 5. The rfd 0.17.2/dialog 2.8.4 update removes ashpd, but upgrading only the direct portal dependency to zbus 6 would add another stack without retiring the notification/vault consumers. See docs/ZBUS-MAINTENANCE-REVIEW.md. Whole-lock scanning keeps this exact finding visible; changed lock bytes, versions, vulnerability/unsound kinds or expiry fail closed. Reassessment remains due 2026-11-15 without extension. Source: https://github.com/RustSec/advisory-db/blob/263a4d951a0867d4bddc29dddd6d59427c78f9a7/crates/zvariant/RUSTSEC-2026-0370.md

Re-reviewed on 2026-11-02 against official RustSec database 263a4d951a0867d4bddc29dddd6d59427c78f9a7 and checksum-verified published CLI/bundler archives: upstream still lists no patched RSA release; a prerelease is not a fix. The patched builder removes RPM OpenPGP entirely. Remaining RSA 0.9.10 has exactly one parent, tauri-macos-sign 2.4.3 (crate SHA256 4478507a7aeee53b73ac780f4f645a584ae07eab599a3d171f8afb258fb02026), gated to macOS in both CLI and bundler manifests. Its only RSA source references are certificate.rs:851-868, generating a fresh key and serializing PKCS8 for a local self-signed certificate, not RSA decryption affected by Marvin. Linux/Windows builders do not compile that dependency. Canonical builds reject signing credentials and isolated updater signing uses Minisign Ed25519. Whole-lock scanning still reports this exact expiring advisory; no upstream RSA patch, warning filter or advisory exclusion is claimed. Reassessment remains due 2026-11-15 without extension. Source: https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/blob/993038c49185307dfc895ab7657d77ca0d5ed7c7/crates/tauri-macos-sign/src/apple_codesign/certificate.rs
